chapter_path_zh: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
display_chapter_path: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义合规计划
stem: 一家金融机构(FI)的一名员工怀疑其一位同事参与了一个金融投资诈骗团伙。该员工接下来应采取哪一步骤?

options.A: 在向公司人力资源部门报告之前，先向同事询问以确定自己的怀疑是否正确
options.B: 利用FI的举报渠道来举报该可疑员工
options.C: 提醒FI的同事和客户，该员工可疑的金融投资建议可能是骗局
options.D: 利用人工智能工具开展开源情报调查，以获取有关涉嫌员工活动的更多信息
options.E: 将涉嫌违规的员工报告给FI的直属经理，由其采取必要的行动

stem_en: An employee at a financial institution (FI) suspects that one of their co-workers is involved in a financial investment scam syndicate. Which step should be taken next by the employee who has the suspicion?

options_en.A: Question their co-worker to determine if their suspicions are correct before reporting to the FI's Human Resources department
options_en.B: Use the FI's whistleblowing channel to report the suspected employee
options_en.C: Warn colleagues and customers of the FI that the employee's suspicious financial investment proposals could be a scam
options_en.D: Conduct an open-source intelligence investigation using artificial intelligence tools to gain more information on the activities of the suspected employee
options_en.E: Report the suspected employee to the line manager of the FI to take the required action
